title: How Dekopon works
description: A clear, release-backed guide to Dekopon v0.4.0: trusted identity, Cedar policy, one-tool scripting, Wasm providers, audit, and OpenTelemetry.

chapters.label: System map
chapters.title: See the whole system
chapters.description: Meet the gateway, model workspace, broker, Cedar policy, Wasm providers, audit trail, and telemetry in one map.

chapters.label: Trusted identity
chapters.title: Where does identity come from?
chapters.description: Follow an authenticated chat sender through gateway attestation, broker mapping, Cedar context, and durable audit.

chapters.label: Cedar permissions
chapters.title: How does Cedar decide?
chapters.description: Build a complete PR-commenter example from principal, action, resource, context, constraints, and a redacted credential.

chapters.label: One-tool runtime
chapters.title: Why give the model homemade bash?
chapters.description: Use the shell habits frontier models already know while keeping processes, files, environment variables, and sockets absent.

chapters.label: Wasm providers
chapters.title: What can a provider reach?
chapters.description: See how each provider starts in a fresh sandbox and receives only the broker-owned host access approved for one action.

chapters.label: Audit & telemetry
chapters.title: How do you see the whole run?
chapters.description: Read a CSS waterfall from chat message to HTTP request, then give audit, traces, and logs their separate jobs.
